$comment: Machine-checked preflight definitions (architecture.md section 5.1). Run by video-capturer and video-editor locally; no LLM judgment. Each fails in seconds with a stable exit code and a one-line reason. Contract lives here and in the scripts' --help output (tools carry their own contracts); dispatch prompts carry only the mission delta.

preflights.fails_when: ffprobe duration exceeds the lane profile cap (90 s hard cap; locked 1:30 decision)
any assemble/trim input sha256 differs from its MEASURED manifest entry, or any referenced beat clip is missing
preflights.mechanism: compare inputs_sha against build/captures/invalidation.json ledger + measured manifests

preflights.fails_when: provenance.json lacks openfilm version, Chrome/engine version, or ffmpeg version
preflights.v1_origin: engine drifted to Chrome 157 mid-run in v2

preflights.fails_when: any capture viewport width < 1024 (locked: no mobile framing; deliverable 1920x1080 only)
capture base URL not in the localhost allowlist (127.0.0.1/localhost) or tenant markers differ from fixture uid 9001 / tenant 1706
lab stack DB host is not localhost (ydlab_layout)
near-blank (uniform-luma) stretches detected in the capture
preflights.mechanism: sampled pre-assembly (camera clamp detector); full-resolution scan is gate G-BLANK in the verify lane

preflights.fails_when: deliverable bytes >= the serve cap (MAX_SERVED_BYTES, 32 MiB — daemon/services/live_views.py:174); an over-cap file does not error loudly — it returns a uniform silent 404 (PathNotFoundError at daemon/services/live_views.py:1279-1283), so the preflight fails in seconds rather than letting the deliverable vanish at serve time
preflights.rationale: threshold DERIVED FROM the 32 MiB serve cap (no invented margin); the serve cap is the real guard, P8 only makes its failure loud and early — document this derivation in the record and in A section 5.1's P8 row
preflights.mechanism: stat the deliverable; compare against MAX_SERVED_BYTES (32 MiB)

exit_code_semantics: 0 = pass; 1 = named check failed (reason printed on one line); 2+ = harness fault (never interpreted as a product verdict)
